body: **Foco:** Emphatic structures — introdução.
**Pronúncia:** Pausas e ritmo.
**22 palavras novas** (pesquisa).
**Texto do dia:** blog, diário, crônica.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar estruturas enfáticas (do/does/did enfático, so/such, never, by no means, the very, at all) num blog.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Blog: Why I Do Love Peer Feedback
paras: I **do** love peer feedback, and I **did** resist it at first. **So** useful is a fresh pair of eyes **that** I now ask for it **at every stage**. It is **by no means** easy to hear criticism, but it is **the very** thing that improves my writing.
**Never** have I regretted asking. **Such** was the effect on my thesis **that** my supervisor noticed. **Not for a moment** did I think I would say this!

items.q: The writer resisted peer feedback at first.

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: **I do love feedback. I did resist it.**
so + adjetivo + that / such + (a) + substantivo + that
**So useful is feedback that I ask for it.**
by no means / not at all
**It is the very thing I need.**
Never / Not for a moment + inversão

blocks.body: O **do/did enfático** só é usado em frases **afirmativas**: *I did say it!* Não confunda com negação.

items.s: ___ useful is a fresh pair of eyes that I ask for it. (So)
Not for a moment ___ I think so. (did)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Why did it change your mind
Never have I regretted asking either
items.pt: Também nunca me arrependi de pedir.

body: **Can’t help but…** — Não poder evitar…
**By no means.** — De modo algum.
**Not in the least.** — Nem um pouco.
**Without a doubt.** — Sem dúvida.
**Beyond a shadow of a doubt.** — Fora de qualquer dúvida.
**Make no bones about it.** — Falar sem rodeios.
**Through and through.** — Totalmente.
**Loud and clear.** — Alto e claro.
**Why did it change your mind?** — Por que mudou de ideia?
**Never have I regretted asking, either.** — Também nunca me arrependi de pedir.

blocks.title: Writing group
lines: I do love peer feedback now, but I did resist it at first.
Eu amo feedback de colegas agora, mas resisti no início.
Why did it change your mind?

items.label: Pausas e ritmo
items.note: Faça pausas curtas entre grupos de sentido (thought groups) e mantenha o ritmo: sílabas fortes em intervalos regulares, fracas comprimidas.
words: In my view, | the plan | is sound.
Having reviewed the data, | we agreed.

prompts.model: So tired was I that I slept.
It is by no means finished.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence blog paragraph with emphatic do/did, so… that, by no means and the very.
blocks.model: I do love peer feedback, and I did resist it at first. So useful is a fresh pair of eyes that I now ask for it at every stage. It is by no means easy to hear criticism. It is the very thing that improves my writing. Never have I regretted asking. Such was the effect on my thesis that my supervisor noticed.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
